modules.name: tb_keyboard_control
modules.description: Self-checking ADC threshold, calibration transaction and note-source velocity testbench

reset.name: rstn
reset.values: all pipeline valid and output data/tag registers clear; external synchronous release

behavior: Drive both polarities, first/second crossing, two-sample confirmation, slow/fast and cancelled gestures.
Write complete/incomplete shadow profiles; check active readback, raw grouped reads, timeout and release-to-rearm.
Connect the actual SynthKeyboardSource and compare each emitted NoteOn velocity and Q26 gain with the originating per-key state.
KBD2 microsecond observation; single-scan crossings must produce interpolated nonzero travel and submaximum velocity; realistic6700us per-key input.
constraints: Simulation only.50MHz clock with accelerated10-cycle millisecond and100ms watchdog.
corner_cases: Both ADC directions; incomplete config; threshold chatter; held key during commit; same-sample fast crossing; long holds; watchdog.
verification_cases: tb_keyboard_control and keyboard_model.py; full tb_studio_system; Rust calibration validation and complete50MHz implementation.

timing_diagrams.title: Threshold traversal and confirmation
timing_diagrams.description: Velocity ends at first press crossing, NoteOn waits for the second.
